periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique tilt with the superior margin leaning laterally away from the sagittal plane.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval morphology with a vertical-to-horizontal ratio greater than 1.0.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering towards the snout, creating a teardrop-shaped inferior margin.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Convex, hemispherical curvature with a smooth, rounded apical profile.
